Puente Hills Mall in Industry, California, famously known from cinematic history, faces a potential transformation into a complex housing warehouses, a transit station, and a 10-megawatt data center. Although local residents and citizen groups have raised environmental, traffic, and noise concerns, the property, purchased two years ago for 115 million dollars, has seen supportive zoning adjustments from the city council. Local organizers continue to push back against the potential public health impacts as discussions around the site's future move forward.

Meanwhile, Nace AI has released Drex for Search, a retrieval layer designed to help agents find evidence across massive document sets. According to company evaluations, the system achieves 92.05 percent accuracy on BrowseComp-Plus using GPT-5 and is built to search over one million files efficiently. The system helps coding agents and decision models navigate complex documents, scanned PDFs, and multi-page tables with significantly fewer search calls and improved execution speed.
